Richard Gerson increased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) by 8.85% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund run by Richard Gerson held 443,000 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $51.87 million, up from 407,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Falcon Edge Capital Lp who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $36.71 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.96% or $2.13 during the last trading session, reaching $106.71. About 8.34 million shares traded or 25.86% up from the average. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has risen 17.73% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.18% the S&P500.
